checks.criteria_rev: spec rev. 60 (U-S9P-13/14/15 (가)): P3-2 T_lim, P3-5 after the first READY, P3-7 > 0.01 W
checks.note: values vs criteria; decisions are control's (284) / dynamics' (physics)

mass_scale.note: spec 422 / decision Q-D (2026-10-29): Chrono plant superstructure body (rigid, crawler included) mass and inertia about its COG x mass_scale, COG kept (= s9_soil_closed_loop.scale_plant_mass); leg rods / pads unchanged; controller unchanged (YAML nominal mass, W_ref, D1'' mass); the 8 s settle runs on the scaled body in Chrono (no A1-m settle approximation); judgement weight p3b.weight_N = plant weight (scaled), P3-7 loaded window 0.01 W_plant = 0.01 mass_scale W_ref (spec 422.6)

basis.weight_N: p3b.weight_N = plant weight (superstructure x mass_scale + leg moving parts) x g: departure / re-contact 0.01 W rules, settle normal checks
basis.W_plant_N: mass_scale x W_ref (plant superstructure): P3-7 loaded-window threshold (422.6)
basis.W_ref_N: C2 meta soil.W_ref_N (YAML nominal, controller): W ratio, WARN_WEIGHT_MISMATCH, S-1 plausibility / reconstruction, P3-7 0.05 W record bucket
basis.F_min_N: P3-3 uses the YAML F_min; F_min x mass_scale is a record only

P3-2_loc.criterion: spec rev. 60, U-S9P-13 (가): crawler_liftoff_confirmed before the first DONE; no LOC while the crawler is loaded (normal >= 0.01 W at the LOC); LOC - departure <= T_lim = plateau_window_m / (push_speed_fraction v_max) + 1 s (ASSUMPTION tail share); the former <= 2 s clause is within_2s_record

loc_timeline.rule: spec 424.8.1: judged LOC = the first LOC after the last revocation (last confirmed LOC); a revocation cancels the latest LOC at / before it; revoked LOCs are records only

late_loc_reapproach.rule: spec 419.8 (decision 13, 2026-10-29): LOC - departure > T_lim is the FLAG P3-2_late_loc_reapproach when 1 a re-approach interval overlapping [t_off, t_LOC] had an LWa window restart (419.8.1), 2 t_LOC - max(t_off, t_re_end) <= T_lim (t_re_end = latest end of the overlapping intervals), 3 crawler true normal < 0.01 W over the LOC period, 4 P3-3 within and no FAULT, 5 LOC before the first DONE; else a failure

late_loc_revoked.rule: spec 424.8.1 (user decision 2026-10-29): LOC - departure > T_lim is the FLAG P3-2_late_loc_revoked when 1 a LOC revocation lies in [t_off, t_LOC^fin], 2 t_LOC^fin - max(t_off, t_revoke_last [, t_re_end when the 419.8 condition 1 holds]) <= T_lim, 3 crawler true normal < 0.01 W over the t_LOC^fin period, 4 P3-3 within and no FAULT, 5 t_LOC^fin before the first DONE, 6 (424.9) t_LOC^fin - t_off <= (1 + n_revoke) T_lim; else a failure

P3-3_leg_force.criterion: true F_cyl min after the departure >= F_min (9415 N); guard + 5 kN recorded; split at departure + 8 s (rev. 40 lift-off transient)

P3-4_attitude.criterion: main judgement (control D-3, 2026-10-26): window [max(two-sided creep stop, last READY entry), t_end]; true attitude (quaternion roll / pitch, absolute, target 0) max |roll|, |pitch| <= 0.2 deg; window < 5 s -> window_short FLAG; no two-sided creep stop -> signed creep stop + creep_vibration_suspect FLAG; end 1 s values, dead band 0.03 deg, post-lift-off max <= 1 deg recorded

P3-5_clearance_stroke.criterion: spec rev. 60, U-S9P-14 (가): min rut clearance (10 Hz) from the first READY entry to the run end >= 25 mm (ASSUMPTION U-S9-C3); s_motor <= 0.6848 m; the minimum after the departure is within_after_departure_record

limit_rule.row: flat, pad B, both rear pads on J1 / J2 / S1
limit_rule.rule: spec 421.1 (Q-A): slope 120 s / flat pad B both rear pads J1-J2-S1 100 s / other flat 90 s

P3-7_plateau.criterion: spec rev. 60, U-S9P-15 (가): S-1 window rise per plateau_window_m >= 4 kN on the windows whose end crawler true normal > 0.01 W_plant (422.6: mass_scale x W_ref); none = pass; > 1 kN (former definition) and > 0.05 W_ref are records; gate: reconstructed t_P / t_loc = C2 meta within 1e-06 s
P3-7_plateau.loaded_threshold_basis: spec 422.6: 0.01 W_plant, W_plant = mass_scale x W_ref (plant superstructure weight; = W_ref at mass_scale 1); W_ref (C2) for the S-1 reconstruction and the 0.05 W record bucket

truth.basis: record.npz F_cyl sum, mean s_motor, same u_applied gate, own LOC

departure.rule: crawler SCM normal < 0.01 W (3801 N) for 0.1 s (P3a-2, dynamics 5.36.5)

pre_liftoff_min_F_cyl.rule: min F_cyl from first > 1.4 F_min to the crawler departure; FLAG < F_min (9415 N), record only

P3-1_crawler.criterion: SCM crawler normal sum = 0 in READY .. READY + 10 s; no recontact after the first departure

recontact_events.rule: U-S9-G6d + Q-G chatter: before the LOC, duration <= 0.5 s, ended before the LOC, max <= 0.15 W -> transient FLAG; after the LOC, start <= t_LOC + 1 s, duration <= 0.1 s, max <= 1.2 x limit, start < READY -> threshold_chatter FLAG (spec 423.3, = late_loc_rule.is_threshold_chatter); else strict fail
